text: I'm Tiffany Boccieri, and I'm running for Laguna Hills City Council Member, District 4.
I believe transparent, effective leadership is essential to preserving the qualities that make Laguna Hills a safe, welcoming, and vibrant community for current residents and future generations.

As a California-licensed attorney and mother, I understand that sound decisions require careful analysis, active listening, and accountability. Whether reviewing a city budget, evaluating a development proposal, or analyzing a traffic study, I will approach every issue with precision, integrity, and empathy.

I grew up in South Orange County and chose to raise my family here because I value the safe neighborhoods, parks, and close-knit communities that make this area unique. I believe every resident deserves a strong voice in the decisions that shape the future of Laguna Hills, and I will work to ensure every perspective is heard.

My volunteer leadership and legal experience have prepared me to formulate effective solutions and deliver measurable outcomes. I will bring those values of service, integrity, and accountability to the City Council.
I ask for your vote this November and the opportunity to be a strong voice for District 4 while serving the entire Laguna Hills community.

text: “Keep it Simple” is my guiding principle for effective governance. I have no political agenda other than to serve the residents of Laguna Hills. As a three-term Chairman of the Laguna Hills Traffic Commission, my dedication to our community is clear. My family has called Laguna Hills home since 1980; I bought my first house here in 2007. My wife and daughter both attended Valencia Elementary and Laguna Hills High School, reinforcing my deep ties with our community.

In addition to my involvement with several HOA boards, I currently serve as President of my community’s HOA. Professionally, I manage a seven-person sales team in the building materials industry for a $2 billion company, giving me the experience to handle complex projects.

My main goal as a City Council member is to ensure a safe environment while enhancing the city’s beauty, thereby raising property values and improving quality of life. If elected, I promise to listen to the residents of Laguna Hills and serve with honesty and integrity. Together, we can make our city an even better place to live.

text: Laguna Hills is my home. I care deeply about our city, our neighborhoods, and the future we share.

My public service experience includes serving as a mayor, city council member, and regional government leader in another California community. I also served our country as a United States Marine and built a career as a cybersecurity officer. Today, I am honored to serve Laguna Hills as the current Chairman of the Laguna Hills Traffic Commission.

My priorities are safe neighborhoods, strong support for law enforcement, a thriving local business community, responsible stewardship of taxpayer dollars, thoughtful planning, and responding to residents.

I am prepared to serve from day one. I will ask difficult questions, study the facts, listen respectfully, and pursue practical solutions that improve daily life. I bring independent judgment, transparency, accountability, and commitment to preserving the character and quality of life in Laguna Hills.

Public service is a responsibility, not a title. I respectfully ask for your vote to represent District 4 while working for the best interests of all Laguna Hills residents with integrity, experience, and dedication to our community and it’s future.
